items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Jeremy Schon & Greg Ormont interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024

ctx.x: Well I don’t want to dismiss goals entirely because I think even with Jeremy’s story on his AHA moment, like he played guitar when he was six, it didn’t really take, but then he saw what it could lead to. Like I saw “Tommy” and I saw what the musical theater path and the guitar path could be. So it made the process, especially early on when it’s very, very challenging or I mean it always is challenging, I knew what I was working toward. It’s hard to enjoy the process if you don’t know where you’re going you know.…
Well said. Last question, are you familiar with B.F. Skinner? © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
We have a song called “Skinner.” And we didn’t know what the intro should be and can you guess what the first two chords are?
